risk_summary: The disclosure is relatively precise and well quantified, but highlights declining sales and volumes, recurring net losses, elevated restructuring costs, goodwill impairment, and rising variable-rate interest expense. Credit risk is tempered by improved gross margin and operating cash flow, although further goodwill impairment and continued macroeconomic, demand, inflation, and interest-rate pressures remain material concerns.
